global.note: Crusader Defence - manifest 13 v18. TWARDY FRONT VIEW: kazdy prompt zaczyna sekcje ruchu od 'Strict head-on front view... never turned sideways', a pozy sa zdefiniowane wzgledem kamery (knee raised toward the camera, sole of the boot visible, foot landing closer to the camera) - takie pozy maja sens tylko frontalnie, wiec kotwicza kamere. Usuniete pozy profilowe (wide stride, leg stretched far behind), ktore ciagnely model w widok boczny. Zakazane slowa nadal nieobecne: 'same', 'identical', 'equal'. 3 pliki na jednostke (<id>_walk/_burn/_slow), 3 kroki 256x256 = strip 768x256, tlo #00FF00 -> rembg, negative ZAWSZE ' ', trzy pliki jednostki tym samym seedem.
global.style_reference: Style: painterly semi-realistic fantasy game art, rich textured brushstrokes, dramatic soft lighting, deep earthy Slavic palette (forest green, amber, aged oak wood, iron grey, blood red accents), early-medieval mythic atmosphere, weathered natural materials, high readability on mobile, crisp clean silhouettes, consistent lighting from upper left.

assets.prompt: Walking animation of a crusader levy footman with a spear and a small shield. Strict head-on front view: he walks straight toward the camera, face, chest and both shoulders squared to the viewer in every step, never turned sideways. STEP 1: full weight on the left foot, right knee raised high toward the camera with the sole of the right boot visible to the viewer, torso swaying to the left, right arm swung toward the camera. STEP 2: full weight on the right foot, left knee raised high toward the camera with the sole of the left boot visible to the viewer, torso swaying to the right, left arm swung toward the camera. STEP 3: both feet on the ground a shoulder width apart, right foot just landing closer to the camera and larger in perspective, body dipped lower mid weight-shift, arms passing at the sides. Each step is a strongly exaggerated, clearly distinct leg pose, all seen head-on. Sprite sheet strip of 3 animation steps side by side. Full body with space under the feet. Painterly dark medieval game art. Transparent background on #00FF00.

front view: weight on right foot, left knee raised toward camera, sole of left boot visible, sway right
